risks.title: Goodwill Impairment
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to goodwill impairment risks due to uncertainties in fair value estimates of acquired assets, particularly related to the Worldpay acquisition and previous acquisitions.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates globally and is exposed to foreign currency fluctuations that can impact revenues and operating results across multiple currencies.

risks.title: Tax Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces tax risks from complex tax law interpretations and potential timing differences between tax deductions and actual tax payments.

risks.title: Intangible Assets Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company holds significant intangible assets subject to regular impairment testing with uncertain value estimates, particularly from the Worldpay acquisition.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces evolving and complex payment industry regulations that could impact operations, compliance costs and financial performance.

risks.title: Acquisition Integration Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces risks from integrating acquisitions such as Worldpay, which could have significant impact on operating results and financial position.

risks.title: Litigation Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company could be exposed to litigation that could negatively impact its reputation and operating results.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning or related technologies is present in the 10-K filing of Global Payments Inc.
